let rA := rP.AuxVarGetRef "*nvfE.oncombatend.1" 0
let rB := rP.AuxVarGetRef "*nvfEC"
let rObj := rP.AuxVarGetRef "*nvfEN"
if rA == rP
  SetFunctionValue "player"
elseif rA == rB
  SetFunctionValue "creature"
elseif rA == rObj
  SetFunctionValue "npc"
elseif IsReference rA
  SetFunctionValue ("ref:" + GetFormIDString (rA.GetBaseObject))
else
  SetFunctionValue (GetFormIDString rA)
endif
End
